body.purpose: Default application copy and supporting instructions.

title.purpose: Compact dialog headings and strong local hierarchy.

label.purpose: Dense operational commands in buttons and controls.

shadows.name: handled-surface
shadows.purpose: Buttons, selectors, clip cards, and inline panels.

motion.name: grid-resize
motion.purpose: Keeps metadata-driven grid correction quiet and legible.

motion.name: utility-reveal
motion.value: max-height 180ms ease, opacity 140ms ease, transform 180ms ease
motion.purpose: Reveals compact action menus without theatrical motion.

motion.name: progress-pulse
motion.purpose: Signals active work on the small status light only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The initiating action or safe confirmation in the workbench rail and dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a4b9e,#1f2b6b); color:#e5e7eb; font:600 13.3333px Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Confirms an action that removes files from the folder, such as Move to Recycle Bin.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { appearance:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,#ef4444 70%,#000),color-mix(in srgb,#ef4444 45%,#000)); color:#e5e7eb; font:600 13.3333px Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact recurring command with quieter hierarchy than the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1e293b,#111827); color:#e5e7eb; font:600 13.3333px Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Collection Selector
components.description: The centered active-context control for pipeline and collection switching.
components.css: .ds-collection-selector { appearance:none; min-width:220px; padding:8px 34px 8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(122,162,247,.35); border-radius:12px; background:#0f172a; color:#7aa2f7; font:700 15px Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; text-align:center; text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(122,162,247,.22); box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-collection-selector:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-collection-selector:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Clip Card
components.description: An inset viewing frame that keeps the moving image dominant and the filename available.
components.css: .ds-clip-card { position:relative; overflow:hidden; min-width:240px; aspect-ratio:16/9; border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.16); border-radius:14px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f172a,#0b1222); box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); color:#e5e7eb; } .ds-clip-card:hover { filter:brightness(1.04); } .ds-clip-card:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(122,162,247,.65); outline-offset:0; } .ds-clip-media { position:absolute; inset:0 0 24px; margin:0; border-radius:10px; background:#000; } .ds-clip-name { position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0; padding:6px 8px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,6,23,0),rgba(2,6,23,.75)); font:400 12px/1.3 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A full-width dark inset field for short collection names and local parameters.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; color:#dbeafe; font:400 14px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; margin-top:6px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25); border-radius:10px; background:rgba(2,6,23,.85); color:#e5e7eb; font:inherit; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:rgba(148,163,184,.4); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A compact decision surface with shared structure for ordinary and destructive workflows.
components.html:
Save changes?

The current view has unsaved changes.
components.css: .ds-dialog { box-sizing:border-box; width:420px; padding:18px 18px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(122,162,247,.35); border-radius:16px; background:rgba(15,23,42,.98); color:#e5e7eb; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:18px; } .ds-dialog p { margin:0 0 14px; color:#94a3b8; } .ds-dialog-actions { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; } .ds-dialog button { padding:10px 14px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1e293b,#111827); color:#e5e7eb; } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-dialog-primary { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a4b9e,#1f2b6b)!important; }

components.name: Context Menu
components.description: A pointer-adjacent utility menu for direct clip operations: an edit of the opened clip first, a destructive command last, each set apart by a divider.
components.css: .ds-context-menu { box-sizing:border-box; min-width:220px; max-width:320px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; padding:8px; border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25); border-radius:12px; background:rgba(2,6,23,.96); box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-context-menu button { width:100%; padding:9px 10px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1e293b,#111827); color:#e5e7eb; font:400 14px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:left; box-shadow:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-context-menu button:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-context-menu button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:0; } .ds-menu-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-menu-icon { width:16px; height:16px; flex:0 0 16px; } .ds-menu-destructive { color:#f87171 !important; } .ds-menu-separator { flex:none; height:1px; margin:2px 4px; background:rgba(148,163,184,.2); }

components.name: Activity Status
components.description: A compact labeled status control: a dot and short text for Ready, Working or the unresolved-error count; only the progress dot pulses.
components.css: .ds-activity-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-width:112px; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.2); border-radius:12px; background:#0c131f; color:#e5e7eb; font:600 13.3333px Arial,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; box-shadow:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-activity-status:hover { background:#141f30; } .ds-activity-status:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgba(122,162,247,.8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-activity-dot { width:8px; height:8px; flex:0 0 8px; border-radius:999px; background:#94a3b8; } .ds-activity-status[data-state="progress"] .ds-activity-dot { background:#22c55e; animation:ds-activity-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-activity-status[data-state="error"] .ds-activity-dot { background:#ef4444; } @keyframes ds-activity-pulse { 0% { transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.32); } 70% { transform:scale(1.06); box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0); } 100% { transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-activity-status[data-state="progress"] .ds-activity-dot { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Clip Sandbox is a low-light working environment in which the moving image is the material and the interface is the bench around it. The visual system should feel cinematic because it protects attention from glare and distraction, but practical because every surface exists to support repeated sorting, reviewing, and clip-making actions.

The incumbent interface combines booth-black space, blue-black working surfaces, screen-silver text, and a single projector-blue accent. Rounded controls and ambient shadows give frequently handled elements a tactile presence, while the media field remains quiet and visually dominant. This is an operational tool, not entertainment browsing: atmosphere supports concentration rather than spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Media-first dark canvas with minimal visual competition.
Compact, tactile controls grouped into a persistent workbench rail.
One cool blue accent reserved for primary action, active context, focus, and selection.
Rounded blue-black surfaces with restrained borders and ambient depth.
Dense but calm spatial rhythm suited to long review sessions.

rules.name: The Single Projector Rule
rules.body: Projector Blue is the only general-purpose accent; use it to locate the current action or state, not to decorate every surface.

rules.name: The Black Frame Rule
rules.body: Video itself sits on true black or near-black so letterboxing and varying source dimensions recede instead of becoming new UI shapes.

rules.name: The Utility Voice Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case and direct verbs; do not introduce editorial headlines, all-caps command chrome, or ornamental type into the operating interface.

rules.name: The Ambient Booth Rule
rules.body: Shadows create separation without looking illuminated; avoid white highlights, glossy reflections, and conspicuous floating-card stacks.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner media and fields use a smaller radius than their containing card or dialog; do not stack identical rounded rectangles inside one another.

dos: **Do** keep video and clip imagery visually dominant over controls and container decoration.
**Do** use Projector Blue for active context, focus, primary action, selection, or direct manipulation feedback.
**Do** preserve the compact `8–18px` spacing and radius vocabulary when introducing new components.
**Do** express errors and destructive actions through Warning Red while retaining the shared component structure.
**Do** let fullscreen and focused-view modes remove interface chrome rather than restyle the media.
donts: **Don't** turn the interface into a streaming catalog with poster-scale artwork, promotional banners, or entertainment-browsing patterns.
**Don't** introduce light canvases, white cards, glossy highlights, or broad decorative gradients into the low-glare working environment.
**Don't** use Projector Blue as general decoration or add competing accent hues outside semantic status states.
**Don't** introduce oversized headings, ornamental display type, or marketing-style copy into operational screens.
**Don't** add dashboard panels, metrics, or navigation structures unless a real workflow requires them.
